_comment: What your officers and the standout hands in the taverns want, and what only they have (scripts/wants.gd). Each person gets one want, picked from those whose traits they have (or the ones with no traits, if none fit), and maybe one asset (asset_chance). A want has a port (home: a town of their own nation; any: any town but a haven), or a target (a named captain from the roster). It resolves by an event in its port (data/events/wants.json, 'want {who} done'), or in code: revenge (beat the target), glory (take a warship), own_ship (give them command of a consort). Help them before 'days' run out and they're yours (opinion +done_opinion, and loyal); let it lapse and they remember (opinion -ignored_opinion; an ambitious one leaves to find a ship elsewhere). An asset works while they're aboard, in its port: customs (seizure chance x), price (better prices), rumours (more in the tavern), cove (they can lead you to a hidden anchorage, once). Lose the person and you lose it. A captain's own want (one who came up from the crew) is their first ambition (data/ambitions.json, 'want'): a port want is seen to when they anchor there, paying its 'cost'.

debt.name: A debt
debt.text: owes 300 gold to a moneylender in {port}, and the interest grows

family.name: Family
family.text: has a family in {port} they haven't seen in years

vow.name: A vow
vow.text: vowed a silver chalice to the church in {port} if they lived through the last storm, and they did

revenge.name: Revenge
revenge.text: swore to see Captain {target} of the {ship} beaten, for what was done to them

glory.name: Glory
glory.text: wants to take a warship: a story to tell for the rest of their life

own_ship.name: A ship of their own
own_ship.text: wants a ship of their own to command

home.name: Home
home.text: wants to see {port} again before they die

customs.name: Kin in the customs house
customs.text: has a cousin in the customs house at {port}: smuggling there is far safer while they're aboard

price.name: An old friend in trade
price.text: grew up with a merchant house in {port}, which gives you better prices while they're aboard

rumours.name: Known in the taverns
rumours.text: knows everyone in the taverns of {port}: two more rumours there while they're aboard

cove.name: A secret anchorage
cove.text: knows the way into {cove}, a hidden anchorage, and can show you, once

_parting._comment: What it costs to lose someone (Wants.part). friends: opinion of the captain for each of their friends aboard; deed: what their home town remembers (data/port_life.json _memory); rival: the chance one you knew (with a want) comes back as a captain (Bonds.former_officer): a friend if they liked you (opinion 30+), otherwise a captain who knows every weak point of your ship. Events: 'leave {r} HOW', 'kill {r} HOW'. inherit (on a want): a friend takes it up when they die; a named captain who killed them is owed revenge instead.
